findings.finding: City screening excludes five cities based on straight-line distance to SVO/DME/VKO or SVX, despite distance having zero score weight. The 500 km rationale is an explicitly unmeasured cannibalisation assumption, not a case requirement.
Holding input utilities and weights fixed, removing the city gate changes top three OMS/KUF/REN to UFA/PEE/CEK; OMS changes from rank 1 to 4. The 400 and 500 km candidate sets are identical.

The shared transfer_min_km parameter gates both connecting OD and all local sales in leg_share. Splitting these gates is necessary for attribution. The dashboard city-filter toggle does not remove these demand gates.

Removing only the connecting OD distance gate changes no selected hub networks in base/cautious replay. Removing the local gate changes multiple networks and the direct alternative. These are diagnostics under existing demand/capture assumptions, not market-validated forecasts.
Fuel support assumption alone changes fixed OMS base contribution from +503.022 million RUB to -531.715 million RUB at the cautious reimbursement parameter. No legal or future entitlement conclusion.

Changing a demand gate also changes endogenous frequencies, seat allocation, fleet and greedy network selection; it need not improve the returned objective. REN diagnostic does not prove a greedy-search bug.

Setting the Kover weight to zero, keeping other utilities and relative weights fixed and retaining 500 km, changes top three to Samara/Saratov/Volgograd. This is sensitivity, not advice to ignore restrictions.

other_material_assumptions: 75 km population catchments; different population universe/year in screening and demand
12-hour rail substitution cutoff and 96-hour imputation for 198/1428 pairs
31 fitted link flows, OD reconstruction not observed OD; published leave-one-out median relative error 55%
Uniform capture fractions; binary presence of direct flight; one connecting path; 1.35 and 1.6 circuity gates; no dated connection banks
Linear net yield fitted to 31 scenario estimates, not 31 actual fare observations
Ufa fuel/handling cost proxies; existing SSJ parameter analogue for SJ-100/PD-8; fixed 10 block hours/day and one spare
Different fleet sizes, forced 8 routes, and hub spokes versus direct triangles in comparisons
Full-year extrapolation, uncertain fleet delivery calendar, full incremental cost/cash and future denominator missing
Correlated population/gap/transfer criteria and min-max scaling across a limited 20-city candidate universe
Route subsidy eligibility, specific awards, rates and seasonality remain scenario-specific

recommended_method.unit: origin zone × final destination × date/season × passenger purpose
alternatives: own existing base with ground access
air connection via own or competitor hub
recommended_method.catchments: Travel-time access and observed airport choices, allowing shared catchments without assigning the same passenger twice.
recommended_method.objective: Compare full-network incremental contribution/cash against a same-period no-project counterfactual at a common fleet budget, including displaced existing business and alternative aircraft uses.
recommended_method.estimation: Calibrate parsimoniously to observed choices and OD counts; validate held-out cities and periods; use explicit ranges if evidence is inadequate. Do not replace 500 km with an uncalibrated weighted regional distance formula.

sources.scope: CAA February 2012, paragraphs 3.123-3.125: travel-time and observed-use catchments and route overlap. Method example; UK numeric thresholds are not Russian calibration.
CAA CAP1135 Appendix F, F13-F18: access, trip purpose, timing and frequency, different passenger segments.
Maksim Diukin 2021 masters thesis abstract, Irkutsk/Zabaykalsky/Kamchatka: generalized trip cost, frequency and accessibility. Regional methodological illustration, not current demand proof.
Dataset primary page: 2026 coverage, 29 June 2026 release. Source implementation caveats additionally documented in pinned author docs/34.

limitations: No calibrated regional mode/airport-choice model was fitted.
Other gates, costs and source weaknesses stay fixed in distance experiments.
No route-subsidy replay, calendar/slots/crews validation, new demand collection or live dashboard verification.
Published model results and scenario sensitivities are not full profit or investment acceptance.
